name: disposition_resolution
description: Canonical decision resolution is open, resolved or risk_accepted. Historical progress, partial-resolution and regression labels remain readable; the owner applies line-specific or operational semantics.

definitions.open: The finding is unresolved on the judged code line.
definitions.fix_in_progress: Historical remediation progress while the finding remains open.
definitions.resolved: The finding is fixed on the judged code line.
definitions.partially_resolved: Historical aggregate: some code lines are fixed and others remain open.
definitions.risk_accepted: The remaining risk was accepted rather than fixed.
definitions.regression_introduced: Historical combination of open resolution and a regression reason.

standard.none: Project-defined classifier vocabulary; existing meanings are retained.

fix_in_progress.note: Remediation progress belongs to the work item.

partially_resolved.note: Requires code-line context: resolved on fixed lines, open on the rest. No unconditional replacement.
